name: Libra — Notify seller of new order / receipt

parameters.query:
-- Returns no row (workflow stops) unless the event is worth notifying.
select o.id,
       o.payment_status,
       o.total,
       o.currency,
       o.transfer_number,
       o.receipt_url,
       o.created_at,
       s.email as seller_email,
       coalesce(s.display_name, s.email) as seller_name,
       coalesce(b.display_name, b.email) as buyer_name,
       coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('name', p.name_es, 'quantity', oi.quantity, 'unit_price', oi.unit_price)) filter (where oi.id is not null), '[]') as items
from public.orders o
join public.user_profiles s on s.id = o.seller_id
join public.user_profiles b on b.id = o.user_id
left join public.order_items oi on oi.order_id = o.id
left join public.products p on p.id = oi.product_id
where o.id = $1::uuid
  and ($2 = 'order.created' or o.payment_status = 'pending_verification')
group by o.id, s.id, b.id;
